info: Expected gaps: a failure a gate reports that is caused by a queued contract request or template finding (__dev__/CONTRACT-REQUESTS.md), not by the component.
Each entry names the check, the template, the cell and the request. The gate asserts the gap still reproduces; once it does not, the entry is stale and the gate fails until it is removed.
An entry is added only by the reasoning tier, with the request it waits on; the execution tier never adds one.

gaps.request: template finding: default color.background_inverse is #ffffff, the page white
gaps.why: an inverse surface draws white on white under the default template until its inverse background is corrected
